steps.natural: An accidental lasts until the end of the bar: every {f} after {fSharp} in that bar is sharp too, without another sign. The natural sign (♮) cancels it: back to the white key, {f}.
steps.naturalTune: Read it from the staff: {fSharp} first, then a natural sign brings back {f} in the same bar.
steps.naturalInTime: Now in time with the metronome.
